question.prompt: To round 3.8 to the nearest whole number, look at the tenths digit. The tenths digit is 8, so add 1 to the ones digit. What is the ones digit 3 plus 1? Calculate: \(3+1=?\)

solutions.explanation: When the tenths digit is at least 5, add 1 to the ones digit. The approximate value is 4.
solutions.title: Increase the ones digit by one
